'''Jacob Noel-Storr''' is an astrophysics researcher and science education and outreach specialist researcher, formerly the lecturer for practical astronomy and X-Lab-PAM team leader at the [[University of Groningen]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-06-25 |title=J. (Jake) Noel-Storr, PhD |url=https://www.rug.nl/staff/j.noel-storr/ |access-date=2022-09-28 |website=University of Groningen |language=en}}</ref> and president of [[InsightSTEM]], Inc. He was an assistant research professor and director of the Insight Lab for Science Outreach and Learning Research at [[Rochester Institute of Technology]], and assistant staff scientist in the Steward Observatory and Flandrau Science Center at the [[University of Arizona]]. He is known for contributions to the study of [[Active Galactic Nuclei]] / Supermassive [[Black Holes]], as well as science / astronomy education and outreach.

Noel-Storr is known for work in equity, inclusion and diversity in astronomy including serving terms as co-chair of the [[European Astronomical Society]] Advisory Committee for Diversity and Inclusion in Astronomy (2019-2023),<ref>{{Cite web |title=accessastronomy.eu - EAS Working Group |url=https://www.accessastronomy.eu/eas |access-date=2022-09-28 |website=www.accessastronomy.eu |language=en-US}}</ref> and co-chair of the [[International Astronomical Union]] Executive Committee Working Group on Astronomy for Equity and Inclusion<ref>{{Cite web |title=International Astronomical Union {{!}} IAU |url=https://iau.org/science/scientific_bodies/working_groups/259/ |access-date=2022-09-28 |website=iau.org}}</ref> (2021-2024), and a member of the [[Netherlands Astronomy Equity and Inclusion Committee]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=accessastronomy.eu - Netherlands |url=https://www.accessastronomy.eu/netherlands |access-date=2022-09-28 |website=www.accessastronomy.eu |language=en-US}}</ref>
